summary: The typed MCP tool media_uploads_upload-media-binary refuses before any file, config or network access, advertises no inputs, and points callers at the upload command mirror.
reason: The 4.32.6 generator binds a free-form 'file' path to a multipart upload, so an authenticated remote MCP caller could make the server read any readable local file and send it to WaveSpeed. Carried forward from the earlier print; the CLI upload command and its MCP mirror stay the supported upload path.
validated_outcome: TestTypedMediaUploadRefusesWithoutReadingFiles fails on the generated handler and passes with the refusal.
